Truncation note (H5): coneDepth=13 dropped 362 nodes beyond that BFS depth

A collapsed node is a bundle of modules: member names are in the hover tooltip, and the graph never invents a module name for it. Clicking a node to open its paper page comes next phase (hooks are in place). This phase is a static graph; the page runs no script.
